deadlinePolicy: Dates are not invented. Each unresolved item is due at a named publication milestone; optional material is omitted when that milestone arrives without approval.

blockers.requestedAction: Confirm the approved Observatory image's authorship or generation source and grant public-display permission, or approve a rights-cleared replacement poster.
blockers.fallback: Create an original palette-locked poster from repository-authored geometry and typography; keep the supplied reference internal until its rights are confirmed.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before task 2.32 v1 content and asset freeze and before any public production preview.
blockers.launchImpact: The current runtime poster may be used for private review but cannot be cleared for public production while its underlying rights are ambiguous.

blockers.requestedAction: Confirm whether the approved /contact route should offer GitHub only, a public email, or a later form, and approve or omit any availability wording.
blockers.fallback: Keep the route informational, link only the approved GitHub account, publish no private address, and make no availability claim.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before the contact journey is accepted for the production preview and no later than task 2.32.
blockers.launchImpact: Identity and biography copy can ship, but the primary contact journey remains incomplete until visitors have an intentionally approved contact action.

blockers.requestedAction: Approve Carlos's exact contribution wording, add a repository license file if MIT is intended, and clear any original screenshots selected for publication.
blockers.fallback: Publish only verified text and canonical links without repository media, sole-authorship language, release claims, or outcome claims.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before the StrudelAI case study changes from held draft to a public project route.
blockers.launchImpact: The project may use its honest text-and-links fallback, but a full media-led case study remains held.

blockers.requestedAction: Approve Carlos's exact contribution wording and authorize a specifically rights-cleared, privacy-safe public screenshot if visual media is desired.
blockers.fallback: Use verified architecture and release facts with canonical links only; publish no private artwork, blend files, GLBs, icons, or workspace previews.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before the Codex Avatar Studio case study changes from held draft to a public project route.
blockers.launchImpact: The architecture can be described conservatively, but contribution attribution and all visual media remain held.
blocks: Codex Avatar Studio full case study

blockers.requestedAction: Choose the public product name, approve Carlos's contribution wording, document location consent and retention/deletion behavior, complete privacy and safety review, and clear any synthetic visuals.
blockers.fallback: Present only the verified research-prototype architecture and open safety questions with no privacy-first, emergency-ready, offline-reliability, or live-service claims.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before the iFoundYou / Dommedag case study changes from held draft to a public project route.
blockers.launchImpact: A cautious research-prototype summary is possible, but the full case study remains held by naming, privacy, safety, licensing, and visual-rights decisions.

blockers.requestedAction: Approve Carlos's contribution wording, repair every installer repository URL, add the intended license, publish passing release or CI evidence, and clear original media.
blockers.fallback: Describe only the verified package and blueprint architecture as an unreleased prototype; omit installer, security, license, provider-breadth, and sole-authorship claims.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before the OpenNemoClaw case study changes from held draft to a public project route.
blockers.launchImpact: A bounded prototype summary is possible, but the full case study and installation actions remain held.

blockers.requestedAction: Approve detailed contribution and collaborator wording, add the intended repository license, and create one original privacy-safe screenshot or demo if visual media is desired.
blockers.fallback: Use verified architecture, package, skill, token, and MCP facts with repository links only; make no sole-authorship claim and publish no repository media.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before the WebDesigner case study changes from held draft to a public project route.
blockers.launchImpact: A verified text summary is possible, but detailed contribution, licensing, and media remain held.

blockers.requestedAction: Create and separately approve a privacy-safe public résumé that removes private identity and contact fields before enabling a download.
blockers.fallback: Publish approved Story and career copy without exposing or linking the private source PDF.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before enabling any résumé download; otherwise omit the download from v1.
blockers.launchImpact: The Story route can launch without a downloadable résumé, while the private source remains excluded from the repository and public site.

blockers.requestedAction: Provide and approve any portrait, signature, or personal mark with explicit reuse permission, attribution needs, and privacy review.
blockers.fallback: Use the repository-authored typographic CC mark and publish no portrait or unverified signature asset.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before adding photographic identity or a supplied personal mark; otherwise retain the typographic v1 identity.
blockers.launchImpact: The portfolio remains intentionally typographic and can launch without a portrait or supplied brand media.

blockers.requestedAction: Create or approve a small original media set for each project with file-level ownership, permission, privacy, caption, alt text, dimensions, and optimization evidence.
blockers.fallback: Use verified typographic summaries and canonical links without screenshots, video, generated imagery, or third-party brand assets.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before any project media is added to the public allowlist; otherwise use the text-and-links v1 fallback.
blockers.launchImpact: Project navigation and summaries can launch, but media-led case-study storytelling remains unavailable.

blockers.requestedAction: Choose the launch tracks and audio sources, then approve files or embeds, artwork, credits, rights, captions, posters, metadata, and player requirements.
blockers.fallback: Keep Sound as an honest mute-first introduction with no playback, waveform, analyser, or audio-reactive visual claims.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before enabling playable Sound Lab media; otherwise freeze the route in its no-playback fallback state.
blockers.launchImpact: The route can explain the intended work, but Sound Lab cannot provide a verified playable or audio-reactive experience.

blockers.requestedAction: Select public videos and provide approved hosts or files, posters, captions, transcripts, credits, privacy review, and reuse rights.
blockers.fallback: Omit video embeds and controls from v1 rather than publishing inaccessible or unverified material.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before adding any video embed or file; otherwise omit video content from v1.
blockers.launchImpact: No primary journey is blocked, but the portfolio launches without video work.

blockers.requestedAction: Select a small set of stories and approve titles, safe place and time granularity, reflections, original images, rights, alt-text intent, and privacy boundaries.
blockers.fallback: Omit travel and hobby stories from v1 and make no inferred location, lifestyle, astrology, or numerology claims.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before adding personal stories to the public site; otherwise omit them from v1.
blockers.launchImpact: The portfolio remains professionally complete but includes less personal context.

blockers.requestedAction: Decide whether ASTRAEA, PINÁCULO, and Future Energy represent real projects, experiments, or visual concepts, and provide evidence before any stronger status is used.
blockers.fallback: Keep the names only as clearly labeled Observatory concepts and do not imply shipped work, ownership, outcomes, or public availability.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before promoting any Observatory concept into a project summary or case study.
blockers.launchImpact: The names may support the approved composition, but they cannot carry evidence-backed project claims.

blockers.requestedAction: Use the completed reference and provenance records to produce rights-cleared candidates, resolve worldwide authoring and display rights, and approve each candidate's originality, likeness, engineering, and optimized output before import.
blockers.fallback: Ship semantic HTML with repository-authored procedural visuals and a rights-cleared static poster; keep the public GLB allowlist empty.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before importing any public GLB or enabling a 3D enhancement tier; otherwise retain the zero-GLB fallback.
blockers.launchImpact: The core portfolio can launch without external 3D assets, but the richer immersive enhancement remains deferred.

blockers.requestedAction: Preserve the completed public-only ledger and 24-case evaluation contract, then select the production model/provider policy, run task 6.30 against the live path, verify privacy and retention behavior, and obtain explicit activation approval.
blockers.fallback: Keep CC AI unavailable and direct visitors to verified static pages and canonical project links.
blockers.resolutionBy: Before enabling the public chat endpoint or presenting CC AI as a working portfolio feature.
blockers.launchImpact: The portfolio can launch without chat, but CC AI remains an explicitly unavailable experiment until live-model, provider-policy, privacy, safety, and user-approval gates pass.

blockers.requestedAction: Resolve or explicitly defer every production and section blocker, record the final v1 include/hold/omit decisions, and obtain Carlos's approval of the public content and asset set.
blockers.fallback: Continue private preview work using only already approved facts and code-authored fallbacks; do not label the project production-ready.
blockers.resolutionBy: At task 2.32, after every preceding Phase 2 gate has current evidence and before production release review.
blockers.launchImpact: Production release remains held until the final public boundary is frozen and approved; implementation and private preview work may continue safely.
